## Checklist

For new or updated solutions:

- [ ] `README.md` / `README_EN.md` follow `solution/template.md`
- [ ] Every `### 方法` / `### Solution` heading is followed by a `<!-- thinking:start -->` **思考** / **Thinking** block (naive idea vs constraints, bottleneck, key observation, why this method)
- [ ] The walkthrough matches the `Solution.py` (or the code actually in the repo) and does not restate the steps below; later methods only cover what the previous method still lacks
- [ ] All languages implement the same algorithm; unrelated `Solution.*` files and code tabs are unchanged
- [ ] Code is formatted as described in `AGENTS.md`
